S.FORM: 泰雅族傳統文化 lubuw na Tayal lubuw ta qani ga, mhyuci, mthhwuy ru kinbalay na hngyang kinbhgan Tayal. ksobeh pqzyu qsliq soya, tluhing, bahing, pqas na qqaya ka knalay ruma. piyux balay squliq misuw mnglung lubuw ga, cisal pssi inlungan mrkyas na tlbugan. ana ga, qaya qani smatu psmyuk squliq na sngya'an. lubuw ga qsliq balay na tlbugan tayal ru mluw balay qnxan ta tayal uzi. maki' balay kinmhgan squ tlbugan tayal qu lubuw. pqzyu qsliq, smbes myugi ru gmluw plubuw pngsa. tbuci plubuw nanak ginaw nya. pcqun lubuw ga gmluw mlubuw p'pira hmali tlubuw. saxa na hmali ini ptnaq wagiq hngyang nya ru ini ptnaq plbugan saxa tayal uzi. yasa tlbugan mrhuw raral tayal squ mhngaw, psqasan, mlata ru pcisan. lubuw ga skalay kya 10cm qrozyux na ruma. plkun bling qrozyux ska ru s'an hmali rum aini ga baliq. sazing syaw tunux sblingan squzi qasing. mlubuw ga qutux qbaq meng ngungu na lubuw. binah qbaq hmuluy gasing pgtuw hmali bung bung hmngyang.ru sgluw p'yugun ngqaw 'myuw hngya' an nya. tayal sraral s'agal ta ruma kbalay lubuw, hmali. kahul ziray Gipun lga, yasa maki' l'ung p'yugun hmali ru hopa cikay hngyang nya.
S.PHON: ******* luβuw na tajal luβuw ta qani ɣa mħju[ʦ|ʨ]i mtħħwuj ru kinβalaj na ħŋjaŋ kinβħɣan tajal k[s|ɕ]oβeħ pqzju q[s|ɕ]liq [s|ɕ]oja tluħiŋ βaħiŋ pqa[s|ɕ] na qqaja ka knalaj ruma pijux βalaj [s|ɕ]quliq mi[s|ɕ]uw mŋluŋ luβuw ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]i[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ][s|ɕ]i inluŋan mrkja[s|ɕ] na tlβuɣan ana ɣa qaja qani [s|ɕ]matu p[s|ɕ]mjuk [s|ɕ]quliq na [s|ɕ]ŋjaʔan luβuw ɣa q[s|ɕ]liq βalaj na tlβuɣan tajal ru mluw βalaj qnxan ta tajal uzi makiʔ βalaj kinmħɣan [s|ɕ]qu tlβuɣan tajal qu luβuw pqzju q[s|ɕ]liq [s|ɕ]mβe[s|ɕ] mjuɣi ru ɣmluw pluβuw pŋ[s|ɕ]a tβu[ʦ|ʨ]i pluβuw nanak ɣinaw nja p[ʦ|ʨ]qun luβuw ɣa ɣmluw mluβuw pʔpira ħmali tluβuw [s|ɕ]axa na ħmali ini ptnaq waɣiq ħŋjaŋ nja ru ini ptnaq plβuɣan [s|ɕ]axa tajal uzi ja[s|ɕ]a tlβuɣan mrħuw raral tajal [s|ɕ]qu mħŋaw p[s|ɕ]qa[s|ɕ]an mlata ru p[ʦ|ʨ]i[s|ɕ]an luβuw ɣa [s|ɕ]kalaj kja **[ʦ|ʨ]m qrozjux na ruma plkun βliŋ qrozjux [s|ɕ]ka ru [s|ɕ]ʔan ħmali rum aini ɣa βaliq [s|ɕ]aziŋ [s|ɕ]jaw tunux [s|ɕ]βliŋan [s|ɕ]quzi qa[s|ɕ]iŋ mluβuw ɣa qutux qβaq meŋ ŋuŋu na luβuw βinaħ qβaq ħmuluj ɣa[s|ɕ]iŋ pɣtuw ħmali βuŋ βuŋ ħmŋjaŋru [s|ɕ]ɣluw pʔjuɣun ŋqaw ʔmjuw ħŋjaʔ an nja tajal [s|ɕ]raral [s|ɕ]ʔaɣal ta ruma kβalaj luβuw ħmali kaħul ziraj ɣipun lɣa ja[s|ɕ]a makiʔ lʔuŋ pʔjuɣun ħmali ru ħopa [ʦ|ʨ]ikaj ħŋjaŋ nja
